# Introduction

For each cytokine, visit (0, 16, 24, 72 weeks), and stimulation condition
(Mtb_Ag, LPS, IL1B), a paired Wilcoxon test (with FDR corrections) compares
the stimulated measurement to the matched Null measurement from the same whole
blood draw. Results are shown as a heatmap where colour indicates the 
standardised effect size and stars indicate statistical significance after FDR correction.

# Load packages

```{r}
#| label: load-packages
#| message: false
#| warning: false

library(readxl)
library(dplyr)
library(tidyr)
library(ggplot2)
library(writexl)
```

# Define file paths

```{r}
#| label: file-paths

input_file    <- "Input/Cytokines_cleaned_log10_Predict-TB.xlsx"
output_folder <- "Output/Figure_S3"

dir.create(output_folder, recursive = TRUE, showWarnings = FALSE)
```

# Load data

```{r}
#| label: load-data

all_data <- read_excel(input_file, sheet = 1)

head(all_data)
dim(all_data)
```

# Filter to successful treatment outcome

```{r}
#| label: filter-data

protein_data <- all_data %>%
  filter(Comments == "success")
```

# Define cytokine columns

```{r}
#| label: define-cytokines

cytokine_cols <- c(
  "BDNF", "CCL11", "Factor_VII", "ICAM_1",
  "IL_1_alpha", "IL_1_beta", "IL_10", "IL_12p40",
  "IL_12p70", "IL_18", "IL_1RA", "IL_3", "IL_4",
  "IL_6", "IL_7", "IL_8", "CCL2", "CCL3",
  "MMP_3", "TNF", "VEGF", "IFNG", "IL_2",
  "pan_IFNA", "IFNB"
)
```

# Paired Wilcoxon test function

For each cytokine, visit, and stimulated condition, patients who have both a
Null and a stimulated measurement at the same visit are paired by ID1. The
Wilcoxon signed-rank test is run on these matched pairs.

The standardised effect size is computed as the rank-biserial correlation:

    r = W / (n * (n + 1) / 2)

where W is the Wilcoxon test statistic and n is the number of pairs. This
ranges from -1 (all pairs decrease) to +1 (all pairs increase), with 0
indicating no consistent direction of change.

FDR correction is applied across all cytokines within each condition and visit
group.

```{r}
#| label: wilcox-function

run_paired_wilcox <- function(data, cytokine_cols, conditions, visits) {

  results <- list()

  for (vis in visits) {
    for (cond in conditions) {

      null_data <- data %>%
        filter(Visit == vis, Condition == "Null") %>%
        select(ID1, all_of(cytokine_cols))

      stim_data <- data %>%
        filter(Visit == vis, Condition == cond) %>%
        select(ID1, all_of(cytokine_cols))

      paired <- inner_join(null_data, stim_data,
                           by = "ID1", suffix = c("_null", "_stim"))

      if (nrow(paired) < 3) {
        cat(sprintf("Skipping Visit %s, %s: fewer than 3 paired observations\n",
                    vis, cond))
        next
      }

      for (cyt in cytokine_cols) {

        null_vals <- paired[[paste0(cyt, "_null")]]
        stim_vals <- paired[[paste0(cyt, "_stim")]]

        complete  <- !is.na(null_vals) & !is.na(stim_vals)
        null_vals <- null_vals[complete]
        stim_vals <- stim_vals[complete]
        n_pairs   <- sum(complete)

        if (n_pairs < 3) next

        test <- tryCatch(
          wilcox.test(stim_vals, null_vals, paired = TRUE, exact = FALSE),
          error = function(e) NULL
        )

        if (is.null(test)) next

        # Rank-biserial correlation as standardised effect size
        # Formula: r = W / (n * (n + 1) / 2)
        # Ranges from -1 to +1
        # Positive = stimulated higher than Null
        # Negative = stimulated lower than Null
        W         <- test$statistic
        max_W     <- n_pairs * (n_pairs + 1) / 2
        effect_r  <- (W / max_W) * 2 - 1   # rescale from [0,1] to [-1,+1]

        results[[length(results) + 1]] <- data.frame(
          Visit       = vis,
          Condition   = cond,
          Cytokine    = cyt,
          N_pairs     = n_pairs,
          Median_Diff = median(stim_vals - null_vals),
          Effect_r    = effect_r,
          P_value     = test$p.value,
          stringsAsFactors = FALSE
        )
      }
    }
  }

  bind_rows(results) %>%
    group_by(Visit, Condition) %>%
    mutate(P_adj = p.adjust(P_value, method = "fdr")) %>%
    ungroup() %>%
    mutate(
      Sig = case_when(
        P_adj < 0.001 ~ "***",
        P_adj < 0.01  ~ "**",
        P_adj < 0.05  ~ "*",
        TRUE          ~ ""
      )
    )
}
```

# Run paired tests

```{r}
#| label: run-tests

stim_conditions <- c("Mtb_Ag", "LPS", "IL1B")
visit_levels    <- c(0, 16, 24, 72)

wilcox_results <- run_paired_wilcox(
  data          = protein_data,
  cytokine_cols = cytokine_cols,
  conditions    = stim_conditions,
  visits        = visit_levels
)

cat(sprintf(
  "Total tests run: %d | Significant after FDR (p < 0.05): %d\n",
  nrow(wilcox_results),
  sum(wilcox_results$P_adj < 0.05, na.rm = TRUE)
))

cat("\nEffect size (rank-biserial r) range:\n")
cat(sprintf("  Min: %.3f | Max: %.3f | Mean: %.3f\n",
            min(wilcox_results$Effect_r, na.rm = TRUE),
            max(wilcox_results$Effect_r, na.rm = TRUE),
            mean(wilcox_results$Effect_r, na.rm = TRUE)))

wilcox_results
```

# Save results table

```{r}
#| label: save-results

write_xlsx(wilcox_results, file.path(output_folder, "Wilcoxon_stim_vs_null.xlsx"))
```

# Heatmap

```{r}
#| label: heatmap
#| fig-width: 10
#| fig-height: 8

cyt_order <- sort(unique(wilcox_results$Cytokine), decreasing = FALSE)

heatmap_data <- wilcox_results %>%
  left_join(
    data.frame(
      Cytokine  = "IL_1_beta",
      Condition = "IL1B",
      Artefact  = TRUE,
      stringsAsFactors = FALSE
    ),
    by = c("Cytokine", "Condition")
  ) %>%
  mutate(
    Artefact   = replace_na(Artefact, FALSE),
    Fill_value = ifelse(Artefact, NA_real_, Effect_r),
    Label      = case_when(
      Artefact  ~ "NA",
      Sig != "" ~ Sig,
      TRUE      ~ ""
    ),
    Cytokine  = factor(Cytokine,  levels = cyt_order),
    Visit     = factor(Visit,     levels = visit_levels),
    Condition = factor(Condition, levels = stim_conditions)   # set last, survives to ggplot
  )

p_heatmap <- ggplot(
    heatmap_data,
    aes(x = Visit, y = Cytokine, fill = Fill_value)
  ) +
  geom_tile(color = "white", linewidth = 0.3) +
  geom_text(aes(label = Label), size = 3, vjust = 0.75, color = "black") +
  facet_grid(~ Condition) +
  scale_fill_gradient2(
    low      = "#2166ac",
    mid      = "white",
    high     = "#b2182b",
    midpoint = 0,
    limits   = c(-1, 1),
    na.value = "grey80",
    name     = "Standardised effect size"
  ) +
  labs(
    title    = "Cytokine response to stimulation relative to Null",
    subtitle = paste0(
      "Paired Wilcoxon test (FDR adjusted) | ",
      "* p < 0.05  ** p < 0.01  *** p < 0.001 | ",
      "NA: artefact"
    ),
    x = "Visit (week)",
    y = "Cytokine"
  ) +
  theme_minimal(base_size = 12) +
  theme(
    panel.grid       = element_blank(),
    axis.text.x      = element_text(color = "black"),
    axis.text.y      = element_text(color = "black"),
    strip.background = element_rect(fill = "grey95", color = "black"),
    strip.text       = element_text(face = "bold")
  )

p_heatmap

ggsave(
  file.path(output_folder, "Heatmap_stim_vs_null.pdf"),
  plot   = p_heatmap,
  width  = 10,
  height = 8,
  units  = "in"
)

ggsave(
  file.path(output_folder, "Heatmap_stim_vs_null.png"),
  plot   = p_heatmap,
  width  = 10,
  height = 8,
  units  = "in",
  dpi    = 300
)
```
